computer.analyze_slot: at the right end: the computer icon with 1 energy, then a blue life trace (the benefit the rival gains when it analyzes, after clearing its computer)

effects.4: advances 4 on the progress track (the income-tuck space)

common.growth_icon: between the orange cross and the blue dot of the progress track: each time the marker crosses it one random advanced card is added to the top of the rival deck

objective_table.round_5: each uncompleted objective: 5 VP for the rival
objective_table.rounds_1_to_4: spend 1, 2, 3, 4 completed objectives at the end of round 1, 2, 3, 4; each one the player cannot spend makes the rival advance 3

progress_rewards.note: 1 progress for each credit, energy and card gained; 4 for a tuck-for-income effect
